name: Contrasting Emotions: Invatuation vs. Rejection
description: I chose to portray the feeling of feeling infatuated with someone who is unrealistic to puruse, and the rejection that can follow. I used heavy color and put ice (unbroken/broken) in the background to show how feelings are fragile. The lighting in Infatuation is dramatic and synthetic, whereas the lighting in Rejection is more even and realistic.
